d:
Where there is love, there is pain too. Rusvaaiyaan, the second song from the Songs of Love album addresses the other side of love and takes you on an emotional journey of heartbreak.
Composed by Amit Trivedi
Lyrics – Kausar Munir
Singers – Shilpa Rao & Shahid Mallya
MUSIC CREW
Produced by Raja Rasaily & Amit Trivedi
Sound Engineer, A T Studios – Urmila Sutar
Assisted by Firoz Shaikh
